name: Nom bo kho
summary: Nộm bò khô is a sweet and sour plate of green papaya, carrot, and beef jerky. One Hanoi page adds crunchy peanuts. A street-food walk adds lemon balm and fish sauce.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list calls it an afternoon snack, and the Old Quarter article places it on Hoàn Kiếm street.
texture: Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list names the crunch of green papaya and carrot and the chew of beef jerky.
taste: Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list calls the plate sweet and sour, with flavoured fish sauce.
howToEat: Ask for spleen and tripe if you want them. Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list offers that version.
Vietnam Tourism’s Old Quarter article tops the papaya and jerky with crunchy peanuts. Vietnam Tourism’s street-food walk adds lemon balm leaves and fish sauce.
where: 23 Hoàn Kiếm, the address on Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nom bo kho — Hanoi beef jerky salad
seoDescription: Nộm bò khô in Hanoi is green papaya, carrot, and beef jerky, sweet and sour, with peanuts on Vietnam Tourism’s Old Quarter article. Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list points to 23 Hoàn Kiếm.
